scope: Move-specific Suite 2 source/runtime reconciliation, including assigned fixes. Suite 2 implementation and local acceptance are closed with the documented nontermination deviation in SUITE2_VALIDATION.json, SUITE2_CLOSURE_REVIEW.md and BATTLE_PARITY_PLAN.md; this document does not substitute test counts or name mappings for branch evidence.

shared_action.source_branches: CheckTurn resolves recharge, flinch, sleep/Early Bird, natural or named-move thaw, confusion, attraction, Disable and paralysis before obedience and PP. CantMove clears the source bond/charge/Rollout/rampage state at its specified failure boundary. IncreaseMetronomeCount runs after that check and before obedience, with called and delayed execution excluded. Obedience uses the player/foreign low-16-bit identity, badges and selectable traded-as-OT option; alternate execution updates the selected identity again. doturn suppresses repeated PP for called/locked continuations, and hastarget owns the direct Pressure cost while permitting initial Fly/Dig/Solar Beam after an opposing faint. failuretext carries the exact failure kind into Blunder Policy; manual move-body messages are separate. endmove is an interpreter sentinel, not a blanket state-reset command.

shared_accuracy.source_branches: checkhit first applies Protect, source Swagger early Substitute, guaranteed-move/No Guard/Poison Toxic/weather/hiding/Lock-On rules, then source affection and exact staged byte accuracy. Intermediate stage, ability and held-item floors remain ordered. The authenticated checkhit-before-checkpriority scripts preserve an existing failure through Armor Tail, Prankster-Dark or Soundproof. Sucker Punch checks its selected-action precondition first; Counter/Mirror Coat do not use checkpriority. checkpowder is a separate earlier branch: Toxic/Thunder Wave may change a successful hit to type immunity without replacing an existing miss, while Sing/Soundproof and powder Overcoat may overwrite it. Magic Bounce ResetTurn preserves the original failure kind and skips a new checkhit roll; its child still reruns checkpowder and priority. Manual confusion/Attract/Foresight/Leech Seed/Trick miss messages and Pain Split ignoring ordinary miss flags are preserved independently.

shared_damage.source_branches: The source compresses raw attack/defense to bytes after item/weather/screen modifications, then applies stage, offensive/defensive ability, burn, Flash Fire, critical and held-item multipliers in the authenticated order before division and +2. Combined STAB/type/weather, Parental Bond quarter damage, Tinted Lens/Filter/Expert Belt, conditional multipliers, 85–100% roll and post-roll doubles/Knock Off retain their integer boundaries. Critical probability is 1/24, 3/24, 12/24 or guaranteed, with source Focus Energy and selectable affection. Dynamic Return/Hidden Power/Magnitude/Low Kick/Gyro Ball and constant/retaliation damage use their respective source commands rather than ordinary modern damage. The selectable classic-category flag reads the source table type before current battle conversion. Light Metal on a source weight-one target is reachable nontermination: the target deliberately uses bounded native arithmetic for that input; this is a documented deviation, not an exclusion or passing parity result.

shared_stats.source_branches: FarChangeStat distinguishes self/target, forced/CANMISS and secondary calls. A primary target accuracy failure precedes the current Substitute helper, Mist from actual Guard Spec, effective stat abilities, Clear Amulet and caps. Swagger retains its earlier doll guard. Secondary effects retain their independent effect chance/SubHit restrictions, then use the same source guards; queued MOVE_NONE is not a reason to fall back to native Illuminate/Mist rules. Contrary reverses and Simple adjusts the requested amount before actual capped mutation; pending Mirror Herb records actual increments and discards consumed or failed checkpoints. Capped forced changes return to the next command, allowing Minimize/Curl to set their own bits.

shared_status.source_branches: Primary source status scripts perform their explicit Safeguard and target guards in script order; CanStatusTarget then resolves current type, held prevention, Substitute, effective immunity/Leaf Guard, existing status and source duration. Corrosion bypass is confined to the authenticated Toxic/Poison Powder and self-orb paths. Secondary chance retains source byte overflow and separates successful chance from successful application through SubHit, Sheer Force, Shield Dust/Covert Cloak, suppression and living-target gates. Confusion has its own Own Tempo/already-confused/doll/manual-failure path and counter; flinch can clear recharge even when its volatile is blocked. Burntarget thaws an already frozen target in seven exact scripts unless Sheer Force, before hit abilities; Tri Attack jumps to BurnTarget and deliberately omits defrosting. A later living-target current-Fire thaw occurs after hit abilities and before Air Balloon/Rage.

shared_damage_faint.source_branches: applydamage clips assigned damage to real HP or doll HP and resolves survival before writing HP. Immediate source ordinary healing/status/stat items and Enigma run at their source checkpoints; Enigma can revive zero HP before postfaint and ignores ordinary pending-loss suppression. Single-hit or final-hit Berserk uses its required pre/post-healing state. criticaltext activates Anger Point and checks Mirror Herb even after an earlier berry capped Attack; supereffectivetext can activate Weakness Policy. postfainteffects orders move recoil/drain and Destiny Bond or faint abilities; posthiteffects checks current doll and failure state, then hit abilities, current-Fire thaw, Air Balloon and Rage, followed by source reactive items and deferred switching. A command return does not terminate the remaining script, explaining Bug Bite after intact-doll posthit rejection.

switching.source_branches: ForceDeferredSwitch retains the first reservation, checks living user/reserves before consumption and preserves exact source switch flags. Pursuit interception precedes departure abilities, and its KO aborts the departure pass. Normal departure clears source state, whereas Baton Pass retains only its specified stage/volatile/history bits. Source Roar alone carries the exact forced-target Mold Breaker hazard context; item switches do not. Simultaneous faint replacements are ordered by departed Speed, all hazard/status/item work completes before both entry abilities, and repeated entry KOs continue the same replacement batch. Faint clearing preserves the victim Mean Look trap until actual replacement. The runtime-selectable Switch/Predict offer and wild faint prompt use their actual production input paths.

BattleCommand_supereffectivetext returns on IN_ABILITY (Parental Bond second hit); for IN_LOOP it runs only when the source remaining strike count is one. It rejects neutral/resisted effectiveness and a faint target, then reads effective target item after Unnerve, applies two independent self-stat raises and consumes only on at least one actual success. It has no Substitute rejection.

Source-present target bindings primarily use BattleScript_EffectHit; alternate native scripts and compile-time effects are explicitly listed per move in this inventory. Future Sight scheduling has no damage; impact uses BattleScript_PolishedFutureAttackHit and BattleScript_DoFutureAttackResult. Its source eligibility must include UsesPolishedHitCheckpoint for active/external impact.

The target resultmessage command is before post-faint/post-hit move-end phases for every source-present EffectHit binding, including the two native multi-hit effects. Source early-versus-late must therefore be selected from the authenticated source move inventory, not solely the target script label.

Cmd_resultmessage waits on controllers and may call survival/endurance sub-scripts and reenter before advancing. It suppresses effectiveness text on active multihit counters, including PB first hit. Do not condition early item activation on stringId being nonzero, and avoid duplicate activation on resumptions.

Late source double/multi-hit must remain after per-hit abilities and only final strike. Early source families must not retry late when the early checkpoint legitimately found both offenses capped; a later secondary drop must not change the checkpoint outcome.

Brick Break has criticaltext -> brickbreak -> supereffectivetext before postfaint/posthit. Target Brick Break additional effect currently follows resultmessage. This micro-order caveat is recorded; no new WP stat/state distinction from screen clearing has been demonstrated.

GetOpponentItemAfterUnnerve calls the current item lookup and only suppresses edible berries under Unnerve. It has no pending-item-loss rejection, so a reserved Knock Off/Thief removal must not preclude the early Policy checkpoint. Current real target HP decides HasOpponentFainted; an Explosion attacker at zero HP does not by itself preclude target Policy.

All 162 early mapped moves reach the two implemented sites: 160 bind directly to EffectHit for all native effect expressions; Struggle either binds directly through Recoil or its EffectStruggle wrapper jumps to EffectHit; Future Sight uses the distinct impact label. Charge/Power Herb/Magnitude/Explosion sub-scripts return to attackcanceler; successful damage continues to EffectHit. Pursuit schedules normal UseMove. Drain/recoil/recharge/pivot effects run later. The other resultmessage sites are failure, status, self-confusion or loop-summary paths, not separate successful early mapped damage.
